## New Case Submission

> Skip this section if not submitting a new case.

**Category:** (e.g., Element Replacement / Camera Direction / Action & Sync / Artistic Style / Cross-Modal / Storyboard / Text Rendering / Comparison)

**Type label:** (e.g., `🎬 Video→Video` / `🔤 Text→Video` / `🖼️ Image→Video` / `🎬+🖼️ Video+Image→Video`)

**Prompt used:**

```
Paste your prompt here
```

**Source tweet (if applicable):** https://x.com/...

## Checklist

- [ ] Prompt is inside a code block (` ``` `)
